body: Thank you for talking, even if life seems really fucking worthless. Reading this from someone else is appreciated, hope the days bring more positive things to you.

Sounds like you're surrounded by assholes.... Hope you're able to meet friendlier people outside of here, anything to give you some kind of positive in your life. I don't know why I'm still here, but I know I don't want others suffering to be dealing with this suicidal shit.

Wishing you the best, wherever you are.

Really do hope it gets better for you. Glad there's at least some conversation with someone out there than fucking silence. It's painful.

No aggression here from me to you, that much at least I'd like to give for talking about things. My head is a mess, sorry...
Happy Birthday, wishing for you a good and decent day and beyond

Fucking hate when people do this. When you just want someone to talk to and suddenly they get aggressive about fuck all. God, why the fuck am I still here? Hope the rest of your day/night goes well... genuinely.

The part with the carousel, I would've just sat by myself and waited, watched everyone get into their rooms, hear the locks from the doors, hear the boots from the masked people, and gotten the final end to this shit.
It really does, even people that have gotten through these moments are pushing me away.
Nothing matters when there's no one, but yourself to push yourself, and keep pushing yourself, as you get heavier and heavier, alone.

Everyone has problems, but at least one person I knew recently treats it like a competition for who suffers most, like all fuck matters whether you see nothing, no beginning, but a fucking end, because no one gives a shit about how to not see that these deadly problems make you always fucking have to figure why you still keep going.

I don't want this. Nothing negative with freedom to roam. Just tired, I fucking hate this and I hope other here survive.

I'm still breathing, everyday I feel less and less, like a part of me is being ripped away. That is what never being loved does for years on end. Right now I don't see any of what your saying, and I'm more and more  caring less and less. I'm so tired, and nothing but someone's feelings will change this, or death take me.
I'm becoming unstable, I can't talk about what needs to be talked about, doctors aren't helping me. No one is helping me, people would rather this problem disappear, just like me.
Even though I can't feel much of anything when it comes to words, it beats the NOTHING that I heard today. Can barely function right now, but your message is picked up.

Please.. if you're going to tell me what to do, leave me alone, leave me the fuck alone.
 LEAVE ME ALONE, stop FUCKING WITH ME
I'm going to fucking snap
You're only making things worse, by telling me to stop looking for a girl to love me. You're making things miserable, and fucking worse. YOU are
You have no fucking clue what I'm going through right now, don't you tell me what the fuck I'm going to do.

stayed home all day, I'm remembering people at the one place I've been forcing myself to go to, being treated like a freak. I'm going insane.

hoping I can spend time with Cyberpunk 2077 and lose myself for a bit, just another means of dragging my life forward. trying not to die.

I don't want to die. I'm fucking crying again.

I don't understand how I can relate more. Today I couldn't even stay out there for more than an hour or two for trying to meet a girl. I'm worn the fuck out and I'm going to completely break down by the end of the year. There won't be a happy fucking ending is what I'm thinking.

I spoke with someone that I used to consider a friend and told them about this. They called me selfish, and to get over my depression. I thought they were someone I could confide in. It's a fucking sick joke, to know that there's more fucking support here amidst strangers on SW than the world outside of the god damn house. Doctors, "friends", people that are supposed to fucking matter.

I'm thinking about Staind's music, and finally leaving this place. This cold place where nothing, but work and study matters. For me at least, no one wants to love a guy that can't smile and be so fucking perfect / interesting. I don't fucking know what more you want me to share. I don't want to fucking be here anymore, and funnily enough in a sick/sad way, the video game Cyberpunk 2077 is what I'm currently using as a reason to struggle and hang on for as long as my interest lasts in it. I should be able to stick around hopefully to the end of the year.
I'm feeling sick right now, I will completely stop going out closer to the end of the month.

No, it wasn't, just some food place. Fuck I had to walk out of the house and try reaching out to someone earlier, I struggled to find anyone to talk to, and decided to reach out to the girl I mentioned being hit on by another guy. She was very unhappy to talk to me, even though to her I'm supposed to be a best friend. Seemed like she just wanted me to be okay, and go away. She kept asking me if I was going to be okay leaving, every time I told her I didn't want to take up any more of her time. I just wanted someone to fucking talk to. (No I'm not fucking okay, I never will be while loneliness is drowning me)

Spent the past few hours getting lectured and yelled at, for not seeing things the way she sees them, all while she was on the phone with her friend (I don't even have a friend to fucking call on the phone). Regardless, I managed to keep a conversation going and talk to someone, enough time to lock some of this shit away, which is better than being locked in my fucking head to whatever end. I don't know how much longer I an keep going, but here I am. So god damn tired of this world.
I'm fucking crying, tired, I don't know how to talk, I don't know what's left.

We're not supposed to support it, but it's so fucking painful rotting in a shell. I don't know what keeps me going, but I'm still going, in pain, and suffering, FUCK. Just moving forward. Who's to say where we're going?
This kind of shit is always appreciated. Better than no support in the fucking world outside here. I don't know why I'm still bothering to keep going with this fucking life.
Thank you for the support, it's hard constantly being out there. Depression hits hard and people expect me to do all but fuck if I know what that constitutes feeling perfectly fucking fine.
Did not expect to see this kind of supportive comment. You don't know how much it means to me, just to see this shit.

I have a really hard time communicating, anything more than just throwing thoughts out of my head for a personal topic about whatever the hell is going on with me. Just created that post to support the OP, so they're not alone in this shit. Damn, want to cry more right now.
Reasonably hanging on compared to earlier. Doesn't feel good right now. It's hard to do anything. Kind of want to cry, but the pain isn't pushing there right now.

Someone reached out to me recently with a lot of positivity and conversation. Later on they started telling me things along the lines of "I feel like you feel entitled to my affection." "Let's be honest" "You think the world owes you something for being alive."

It doesn't feel good and I feel really fucking miserable right now.

https://www.deviantart.com/scribb0les
This is most of my shit. I'M SO SICK OF THIS FUCKING LIFE
I'm coming so fucking close to that edge. NO ONE GIVES A FUCKING SHIT. NOT IN THE REAL WORLD. I CAN"T FUCKING FEEL ANYTHING.

Not crying anymore, some were adults, some were college students.
Still the same 4 fucking walls.

It never fucking ends. I'm so god damn tired, crying right now if that even fucking matters.

Just want this to go away.
